تعتورين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَوِرِينَ (taʕtawirīna) /taʕ.ta.wi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# تُعْتَوَرِينَ (tuʕtawarīna) /tuʕ.ta.wa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
